The homogeneous solution is  
\[
y_h=e^{-x}(C_1\cos 2x+C_2\sin 2x).
\]
A particular solution is  
\[
y_p=2\cos x+\sin x.
\]
So
\[
y=e^{-x}(C_1\cos 2x+C_2\sin 2x)+2\cos x+\sin x.
\]
Using \(y(0)=0\) and \(y'(0)=0\), we get
\[
C_1=-2,\qquad C_2=-\frac32.
\]
Thus
\[
y(x)=e^{-x}\left(-2\cos 2x-\frac32\sin 2x\right)+2\cos x+\sin x.
\]
Then
\[
y(\pi)=e^{-\pi}(-2)-2=-2(1+e^{-\pi})\approx -2.0864278.
\]
Rounded to 4 decimal places:
\[
\boxed{-2.0864}
\]

ANSWER: -2.0864
